title: SKILL.md: the Testing row and shape use the two gates
description:
Bring skills/ticks/SKILL.md in line with the two gates.

- Rewrite the `## Testing` row of the per-project config table so its consumer and when columns name the tick gate and the wave gate.
- In prose, describe the recommended shape of `## Testing`: commands grouped under the two gate names, with no new syntax. Another skill's bootstrap template will copy this wording as a commandless skeleton, so make it short and exact.
- Align the inferred-profile paragraph and the "Running the Epic" step 4 comment.

Spec (source of truth): docs/thoughts/2026-11-12-lean-epics.md. Edit only files under skills/ticks/ (never an installed copy). Settled names, use exactly: the "tick gate" (per tick, in the worktree, run by the implementer: typecheck, the tests the change reaches, the build) and the "wave gate" (per wave, or per chain integration, run by the integrator: the full suite, slow suites, specs, shared generated outputs regenerated once). The existing in-worktree/post-merge "venues" stay: a venue says where a test tier is safe to run; the gates say who runs what, when. Add no new config syntax: `## Testing` may group commands under the two gate names in prose; the project maps commands to gates. Keep the engine voice: terse, no step lists where a criterion will do.
